entries.en: The conference included a discussion of international cooperation against bioterrorism.
entries.zh: 会议包括了一场关于国际合作打击生物恐怖活动的讨论。

entries.en: The novel follows a hobo travelling between railway towns in search of work.
entries.zh: 这部小说描写一名流浪汉沿铁路往来于各个城镇寻找工作的经历。

entries.en: The programmer used a heuristic approach to find a workable route quickly.
entries.zh: 程序员采用启发式方法，迅速找到了一条可行路线。

entries.en: Our beagle followed an interesting scent all the way to the gate.
entries.zh: 我们的比格犬循着一股有趣的气味，一直追到了大门口。

entries.en: The museum plans to reactivate the old fountain for its summer festival.
entries.zh: 博物馆计划在夏季庆典期间重新启用那座旧喷泉。

entries.en: The team tested a new countermeasure against unwanted messages on the network.
entries.zh: 团队测试了一项应对网络上垃圾消息的新措施。

entries.en: Water dripped from the outdoor spigot onto the paving stones below.
entries.zh: 水从室外水龙头滴落在下面的铺路石上。

entries.en: Our nosy neighbour wanted to know who had visited us yesterday.
entries.zh: 我们那位爱打听的邻居想知道昨天是谁来拜访了我们。

entries.en: The instructor nodded encouragingly as I attempted my first turn on skis.
entries.zh: 我尝试第一次滑雪转弯时，教练鼓励地点了点头。

entries.en: The geologist pointed out a small nodule embedded in the limestone.
entries.zh: 地质学家指着嵌在石灰岩中的一个小结节给我们看。

entries.en: We could hear the church bells ringing distantly across the valley.
entries.zh: 我们能隐约听见山谷另一头传来的教堂钟声。

entries.en: Under the fictional policy, residents were compulsorily relocated outside the city.
entries.zh: 按照那项虚构的政策，居民被强制迁往城外。

entries.en: She used a fork to crimp the edges of each pastry.
entries.zh: 她用叉子在每个馅饼的边缘压出褶纹。

entries.en: A short promo for the new series played before the evening news.
entries.zh: 晚间新闻之前播放了一段新剧的简短宣传广告。

entries.en: The antiquarian carefully examined the faded map before making an offer.
entries.zh: 那位古文物收藏家仔细检查了褪色的地图，然后才出价。

entries.en: The machine perforated the paper so each ticket could be torn off easily.
entries.zh: 机器在纸上打了齿孔，使每张票都容易撕下。

entries.en: A slight readjustment of the mirror gave her a clearer view behind.
entries.zh: 稍微重新调整一下镜子后，她更清楚地看到了后方。

entries.en: The sharpshooter hit the distant target during the exhibition at the fair.
entries.zh: 集市表演中，那位神枪手击中了远处的靶子。

entries.en: The experienced litigator spent the afternoon reviewing files for the coming trial.
entries.zh: 那位经验丰富的诉讼律师整个下午都在审阅即将开庭案件的材料。

entries.en: The villagers hid their supplies when marauding soldiers approached the valley.
entries.zh: 四处抢掠的士兵接近山谷时，村民们藏起了物资。

entries.en: The traveller objected when the stranger called him a gringo.
entries.zh: 那个陌生人称这位旅行者为“外国佬”时，旅行者表示了不满。

entries.en: A carved stone lintel spanned the doorway of the old cottage.
entries.zh: 一根雕花石过梁横跨在旧农舍的门洞上方。

entries.en: The student labelled the sulfide sample before placing it in the tray.
entries.zh: 学生给那份硫化物样品贴上标签，然后放进了托盘。

entries.en: The rescue team redoubled its efforts as the daylight began to fade.
entries.zh: 天色开始变暗时，救援队加倍努力展开搜救。

entries.en: The quiet office manager was the linchpin of the entire organisation.
entries.zh: 那位安静的办公室主管是整个机构的关键人物。

entries.en: The bus crawled around another switchback on the steep mountain road.
entries.zh: 公交车在陡峭山路上又缓缓绕过了一处之字形急弯。

entries.en: The novel's plot centres on the entrapment of a trusting young merchant.
entries.zh: 小说情节围绕一个轻信他人的年轻商人被诱入圈套展开。

entries.en: The biography explores the writer's long friendship with a prominent psychoanalyst.
entries.zh: 这本传记探讨了那位作家与一位著名精神分析家之间的长期友谊。

entries.en: A resurgent interest in pottery brought new visitors to the workshop.
entries.zh: 对陶艺重新兴起的兴趣，为工坊带来了新的访客。

entries.en: The harvester moved steadily across the field of ripe wheat.
entries.zh: 收割机在成熟的麦田里平稳地前进。

entries.en: A purple petunia bloomed in the cracked pot beside the steps.
entries.zh: 台阶旁的裂纹花盆里开着一朵紫色矮牵牛花。

entries.en: The cliff revealed stratified rock in alternating bands of red and grey.
entries.zh: 悬崖上露出的分层岩石呈现红灰相间的条带。

entries.meaningZh: 柴束（此处为英式木柴义；该词另有侮辱同性恋男性的严重冒犯义，勿用来称人）
entries.en: The woodcutter carried a faggot of dry branches back to his cottage.
entries.zh: 樵夫扛着一捆干树枝，回到了自己的小屋。

entries.en: A nauseous smell rose from the rubbish bin behind the kitchen.
entries.zh: 厨房后面的垃圾桶散发出一股令人作呕的气味。

entries.en: A rusty padlock hung from the chain securing the garden gate.
entries.zh: 锁住花园大门的链条上挂着一把生锈的挂锁。

entries.en: The guards attacked ferociously, driving the unarmed villagers from the square.
entries.zh: 卫兵们凶狠地发动攻击，把手无寸铁的村民赶出了广场。

entries.en: The food stall had clean surfaces and a separate hygienic washing area.
entries.zh: 食品摊的台面干净，还设有独立、卫生的清洗区。

entries.en: The designer chose hexagonal tiles for the floor of the small bathroom.
entries.zh: 设计师为小浴室的地面选择了六边形瓷砖。

entries.en: An offscreen voice called her name as the camera followed the train.
entries.zh: 镜头跟随火车移动时，画面外传来了呼唤她名字的声音。

entries.en: The painter used ochre to capture the colour of the dry hills.
entries.zh: 画家用赭石颜料描绘干燥山丘的颜色。

entries.en: She was elected unopposed after the only other candidate withdrew.
entries.zh: 唯一的另一位候选人退出后，她在无人竞争的情况下当选。

entries.en: The inquiry uncovered widespread illegality in the company's disposal of waste.
entries.zh: 调查发现，该公司在废物处理方面存在广泛的违法行为。

entries.en: The committee met again in pursuance of its plan to restore the hall.
entries.zh: 为落实修复礼堂的计划，委员会再次召开了会议。

entries.en: A jackal paused at the edge of the clearing before moving away.
entries.zh: 一只豺在林间空地的边缘停了停，然后离开了。

entries.en: His pedantic corrections of every minor detail soon annoyed the group.
entries.zh: 他对每个细节都作学究式的纠正，很快惹恼了大家。

entries.en: The warm afternoon gave us a foretaste of the coming summer.
entries.zh: 这个温暖的下午让我们预先感受到了即将到来的夏天。

entries.en: The historian examined the economic grievances that had encouraged regional separatism.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了那些助长地区分离主义的经济不满。

entries.en: A thunderbolt struck the old oak tree at the edge of the field.
entries.zh: 一道霹雳击中了田边那棵老橡树。

entries.en: Dancers gathered at the annual powwow while families watched from nearby seats.
entries.zh: 舞者们聚集在一年一度的帕瓦聚会上，各家人在附近的座位上观看。

entries.en: The exhibition recalled the seaside holidays of yesteryear through postcards and photographs.
entries.zh: 展览通过明信片和照片，再现了往昔的海滨假日。

entries.en: A bevy of excited reporters waited outside the theatre's main entrance.
entries.zh: 一群兴奋的记者在剧院正门外等候。

entries.meaningZh: 束缚手臂的紧身约束衣
entries.en: The museum displayed a straitjacket beside photographs of the former institution.
entries.zh: 博物馆在那个旧机构的照片旁展示了一件束缚手臂的约束衣。

entries.en: I arrived under the misapprehension that the meeting would include lunch.
entries.zh: 我来时误以为会议会提供午餐。

entries.en: Her excellent comedic timing turned a simple pause into a memorable joke.
entries.zh: 她出色的喜剧节奏感，让一个简单的停顿变成了令人难忘的笑点。

entries.en: The distorted mirror made our faces look grotesquely long and narrow.
entries.zh: 那面变形镜把我们的脸照得又长又窄，十分怪诞。

entries.en: A portly gentleman in a wool coat squeezed into the narrow seat.
entries.zh: 一位穿羊毛大衣的肥胖先生费力挤进了狭窄的座位。

entries.en: Her truthfulness gave the committee confidence in the rest of her account.
entries.zh: 她的诚实让委员会对她叙述的其余部分也有了信心。

entries.en: The ruler's warlike speeches worried neighbouring states and unsettled the merchants.
entries.zh: 那位统治者好战的演说令邻国担忧，也让商人感到不安。

entries.en: The circus strongman lifted an enormous weight above his head.
entries.zh: 马戏团的大力士把一个巨大的重物举过头顶。

entries.en: We read the map by firelight after the torch batteries ran out.
entries.zh: 手电筒电池耗尽后，我们借着火光看地图。

entries.en: She felt indescribable joy when her missing dog came running home.
entries.zh: 失踪的狗跑回家时，她感到难以言表的喜悦。

entries.en: Heavy snow made the mountain pass impassable for several days.
entries.zh: 大雪使山口连续数日无法通行。

entries.en: Years of strong sunlight had discoloured the fabric near the window.
entries.zh: 多年强烈的日照使窗边的布料变了色。

entries.en: A bespectacled librarian helped us locate the old newspaper collection.
entries.zh: 一位戴眼镜的图书管理员帮我们找到了旧报纸的馆藏。

entries.en: The jacket has a detachable hood for warmer spring days.
entries.zh: 这件夹克配有可拆卸的兜帽，适合较暖和的春日。

entries.en: They rejected the derisory offer for a collection worth far more.
entries.zh: 那批藏品价值高得多，他们拒绝了这个低得可笑的报价。

entries.en: Her sensitive musicianship brought warmth to even the simplest piano piece.
entries.zh: 她细腻的音乐素养让最简单的钢琴曲也充满温情。

entries.en: The creaky stairs made it impossible to leave the house quietly.
entries.zh: 楼梯嘎吱作响，让人没法悄悄离开屋子。

entries.en: For the team, it was axiomatic that every result needed checking.
entries.zh: 对团队而言，每个结果都需要核查是不言自明的。

entries.en: His record collection ranges from gentle folk music to hard-edged gangsta.
entries.zh: 他的唱片收藏涵盖了从轻柔民谣到风格强硬的冈斯特说唱乐的各种音乐。

entries.en: He helped his stepdaughter build a bookshelf for her new bedroom.
entries.zh: 他帮继女给她的新卧室做了一个书架。

entries.en: The zoo guide explained why this large herbivore needed so much vegetation.
entries.zh: 动物园导游解释了为什么这种大型草食动物需要吃这么多植物。

entries.en: The diagram used arrows to show blood moving through the circulatory system.
entries.zh: 示意图用箭头展示了血液在循环系统中的流动。

entries.en: The clock stopped unaccountably just before midnight and started again at dawn.
entries.zh: 那座钟在午夜前莫名其妙地停了，到黎明又走了起来。

entries.en: One wooden trestle supported each end of the temporary workbench.
entries.zh: 临时工作台的两端各由一个木支架支撑。

entries.en: An experienced gamer showed me how to change the controller settings.
entries.zh: 一位经验丰富的游戏玩家教我如何修改手柄设置。

entries.en: An algal bloom turned the surface of the pond bright green.
entries.zh: 藻类大量繁殖，使池塘表面变得鲜绿。

entries.en: She never doubted the rightness of her decision to tell the truth.
entries.zh: 她从未怀疑过自己决定说实话是正确的。

entries.en: His expression of incomprehension showed that I needed to explain again.
entries.zh: 他一脸不解，表明我需要再解释一遍。

entries.en: Her bossy manner annoyed the other volunteers during the picnic preparations.
entries.zh: 准备野餐时，她爱发号施令的态度惹恼了其他志愿者。

entries.en: A crawfish hid beneath a flat stone in the shallow stream.
entries.zh: 一只小龙虾藏在浅溪里的一块扁石头下面。

entries.en: The science exhibition used animations to introduce visitors to antimatter.
entries.zh: 科学展览用动画向参观者介绍反物质。

entries.en: A club bylaw requires members to return borrowed equipment before Friday.
entries.zh: 俱乐部的一条细则要求会员在星期五之前归还借用的设备。

entries.en: The researcher compared retinal images displayed on two large monitors.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了两台大显示器上显示的视网膜图像。

entries.en: The oversized hat sat comically low over the little boy's eyes.
entries.zh: 那顶过大的帽子低低地盖住小男孩的眼睛，模样十分滑稽。

entries.en: Nobody wanted to be the spoiler who ended the party early.
entries.zh: 谁也不想当那个提前结束聚会、让大家扫兴的人。

entries.en: The medieval painting contrasts the promise of salvation with the fear of damnation.
entries.zh: 这幅中世纪画作把得救的希望与被罚入地狱的恐惧相对照。

entries.en: The memoir describes years of arguments over alimony after the divorce.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录描述了离婚后多年来围绕配偶赡养费发生的争执。

entries.en: We discovered a mouldy loaf at the back of the cupboard.
entries.zh: 我们在橱柜深处发现了一条发霉的面包。

entries.en: The bagpiper wore a green tartan kilt during the wedding procession.
entries.zh: 婚礼队伍中，风笛手穿着一条绿色格纹苏格兰裙。

entries.en: Workers lifted the manhole cover to inspect the drain beneath the road.
entries.zh: 工人们掀起人孔盖，检查道路下方的排水管。

entries.en: A small arrowhead on the diagram showed the direction of travel.
entries.zh: 图中的一个小箭头尖标出了行进方向。

entries.en: The engine ran well, but the bodywork needed extensive repairs.
entries.zh: 发动机运转良好，但车身需要大修。

entries.en: The laptop's portability mattered more to her than a larger screen.
entries.zh: 对她来说，笔记本电脑的便携性比更大的屏幕更重要。

entries.en: Gauzy curtains softened the sunlight entering the bedroom in the afternoon.
entries.zh: 薄纱般的窗帘使午后照进卧室的阳光变得柔和。

entries.en: Someone had tried to vandalise the mural with black paint overnight.
entries.zh: 夜里有人试图用黑漆故意毁坏那幅壁画。

entries.en: The archivist examined the map and the handwritten notes thereon.
entries.zh: 档案管理员查看了地图及其上面的手写注释。

entries.en: A soft sheepskin covered the wooden seat beside the fireplace.
entries.zh: 壁炉旁的木座上铺着一张柔软的绵羊皮。

entries.en: The nearness of the railway station made the flat especially convenient.
entries.zh: 这套公寓离火车站很近，因此格外方便。

entries.en: Her older sister remained her closest confidante throughout the difficult year.
entries.zh: 在那艰难的一年里，姐姐始终是她最亲密的知己。

entries.en: The collector showed us a delicate comb made from early celluloid.
entries.zh: 那位收藏家给我们看了一把用早期赛璐珞制成的精致梳子。

entries.en: The jazz singer ended her solo with a burst of lively scat.
entries.zh: 那位爵士歌手以一段活泼的拟声演唱结束了独唱。

entries.en: Their inductive reasoning moved from repeated observations towards a general explanation.
entries.zh: 他们的归纳推理从反复观察出发，逐步形成一般性解释。

entries.en: The damaged boat had a lightweight hull reinforced with fibreglass.
entries.zh: 那艘受损的船有一个用玻璃纤维加固的轻质船体。

entries.en: An inconspicuous sign beside the door pointed visitors towards the gallery.
entries.zh: 门旁一块不起眼的标牌为访客指明了画廊的方向。

entries.en: A small warbler sang from a branch above the woodland path.
entries.zh: 一只小莺在林间小路上方的树枝上鸣唱。

entries.en: She touched her earlobe and realised that one earring was missing.
entries.zh: 她摸了摸耳垂，发现一只耳环不见了。

entries.en: The thinness of the paper made writing on both sides difficult.
entries.zh: 纸太薄，很难在正反两面都写字。

entries.en: A deathly silence filled the room after the unexpected announcement.
entries.zh: 那条意外消息公布后，房间里一片死寂。

entries.en: The children played leapfrog on the grass until the picnic was ready.
entries.zh: 孩子们在草地上玩跳背游戏，直到野餐准备好了。

entries.en: The trainees practised resuscitation on a mannequin under the instructor's supervision.
entries.zh: 学员们在教练监督下，利用模拟人练习复苏术。

entries.en: The report warned that secrecy was prejudicial to public confidence in the project.
entries.zh: 报告警告说，保密做法有损公众对该项目的信心。

entries.en: The program numbers the photographs sequentially as it saves each file.
entries.zh: 程序保存每个文件时，会按顺序给照片编号。

entries.en: Her exegesis of the poem examined each image in its historical context.
entries.zh: 她对这首诗的详细阐释，把每个意象都放在历史背景中考察。

entries.en: The shop kept its porno on a separate shelf behind the counter.
entries.zh: 商店把色情刊物放在柜台后面一个单独的架子上。

entries.en: The room smelled stale, and the unclean windows barely let in light.
entries.zh: 房间里有一股陈腐的气味，脏兮兮的窗户几乎透不进光。

entries.en: The film follows three thieves planning a heist at a jewellery exhibition.
entries.zh: 电影讲述了三个盗贼策划抢劫珠宝展览的故事。

entries.en: The story follows an unloved child who finds friendship at a new school.
entries.zh: 故事讲述一个缺少关爱的孩子在新学校交到朋友的经历。

entries.en: We camped at the southernmost tip of the island for two nights.
entries.zh: 我们在岛的最南端露营住了两晚。

entries.en: The final chapter leaves readers with an unanswerable question about the stranger.
entries.zh: 最后一章给读者留下了一个关于那个陌生人的、无法回答的问题。

entries.en: The flat has a smallish kitchen but a surprisingly spacious bedroom.
entries.zh: 这套公寓的厨房有点小，但卧室出人意料地宽敞。

entries.en: The piano tuner arrived early and began testing the lowest notes.
entries.zh: 钢琴调音师提前到达，开始试弹最低的几个音。

entries.en: The greenhouse maintains a subtropical climate for its collection of rare plants.
entries.zh: 温室为收藏的珍稀植物维持着亚热带气候环境。

entries.en: The receptionist obligingly printed another map when mine blew into the river.
entries.zh: 我的地图被风吹进河里后，接待员友善地又给我打印了一张。

entries.en: The researchers were theorizing about the pattern before testing it with new data.
entries.zh: 研究人员先就这一模式进行理论推断，随后再用新数据检验。

entries.en: I often mislay my glasses when I move between different rooms.
entries.zh: 我在不同房间之间走动时，经常把眼镜随手一放就找不到了。

entries.en: The detective discovers that the king's slayer was someone inside the palace.
entries.zh: 侦探发现，杀害国王的凶手是王宫内部的人。

entries.en: The classroom model showed where the eardrum sits inside the ear.
entries.zh: 教室里的模型展示了鼓膜在耳内的位置。

entries.en: He imagined the office job would be cushy until the busy season began.
entries.zh: 旺季开始之前，他一直以为那份办公室工作会很轻松。

entries.en: She stared glumly at the rain and put her walking boots away.
entries.zh: 她闷闷不乐地望着雨，把徒步靴收了起来。

entries.en: The teacher asked us to underline the reflexive pronouns in the paragraph.
entries.zh: 老师让我们在这一段的反身代词下面画线。

entries.en: Please wipe your muddy boots on the doormat before coming inside.
entries.zh: 进屋之前，请先在擦鞋垫上擦掉靴子上的泥。

entries.en: She chose plain curtains instead of the frilly ones in the catalogue.
entries.zh: 她选择了素净的窗帘，而没有选目录里带褶边的款式。

entries.en: The house looked depressingly empty after all the furniture had gone.
entries.zh: 家具搬空之后，房子空荡得令人沮丧。

entries.en: The fortress's capitulation brought the long siege to an abrupt end.
entries.zh: 堡垒的投降使漫长的围困骤然结束。

entries.en: She gazed dreamily out of the train window at the passing fields.
entries.zh: 她出神地望着火车窗外掠过的田野。

entries.en: One loose flagstone rocked under my foot near the garden gate.
entries.zh: 花园大门附近有一块松动的石板，我踩上去时它晃了一下。

entries.en: The receptionist remained unruffled despite the queue of angry guests.
entries.zh: 尽管愤怒的客人排起了队，接待员仍镇定自若。

entries.en: In the legend, the young hero was divinely protected throughout his journey.
entries.zh: 传说中，年轻的英雄在整个旅途中都受到神力保护。

entries.en: The display contrasted durable metal cups with cheap plastic throwaways.
entries.zh: 这组展品把耐用的金属杯与廉价的一次性塑料用品作了对比。

entries.en: We played croquet on the lawn while dinner cooked in the oven.
entries.zh: 晚餐在烤箱里烹制时，我们在草坪上玩槌球。

entries.en: He changed his shirt to look presentable before the visitors arrived.
entries.zh: 客人到来之前，他换了件衬衫，让自己看起来体面些。

entries.en: Out of sheer perversity, he chose the one seat everyone wanted left empty.
entries.zh: 他纯粹是故意作对，偏偏选了大家都希望空着的那个座位。

entries.en: The family waited for probate before the executor could distribute the estate.
entries.zh: 家人等待遗嘱认证完成，之后遗嘱执行人才可以分配遗产。

entries.en: The museum's prehistory gallery displayed tools found beneath the nearby hills.
entries.zh: 博物馆的史前史展厅展出了在附近山丘下发现的工具。

entries.en: The banality of the dialogue weakened an otherwise inventive film.
entries.zh: 台词的陈腐平庸削弱了这部本来颇有创意的电影。

entries.en: The trombone player extended the slide as the marching band turned the corner.
entries.zh: 行进乐队转过街角时，长号演奏者把伸缩管向外拉长。

entries.en: The anchorman introduced a live report from the newly opened railway station.
entries.zh: 那位新闻男主持人引出了一则来自新开通火车站的现场报道。

entries.en: The model boat has a controllable rudder and a small electric motor.
entries.zh: 这艘模型船有一个可操控的船舵和一台小电动机。

entries.en: The actor entered imaginatively into the character's lonely childhood while preparing the role.
entries.zh: 准备角色时，演员通过想象体会了人物孤独的童年。

entries.meaningZh: 同质的（homogeneous的变体拼写；部分词典标为非标准，规范写作宜用homogeneous）
entries.en: The material appeared homogenous, but closer inspection revealed tiny grains of sand.
entries.zh: 这种材料看起来质地均一，但仔细检查后发现了细小的沙粒。

entries.en: The newly restored theatre opened grandly with fireworks and a full orchestra.
entries.zh: 修复一新的剧院以烟花和完整管弦乐队的演出盛大开幕。

entries.en: The reverberation of the final drumbeat faded slowly inside the empty hall.
entries.zh: 最后一声鼓响的回声在空荡的大厅里缓缓消散。

entries.en: The novel is set in a remote borderland between two rival kingdoms.
entries.zh: 小说的背景设在两个敌对王国之间一片偏远的边境地区。

entries.en: The manager kept a small reserve for any unforeseen exigency.
entries.zh: 经理留了一小笔储备，以应付任何意料之外的紧急情况。

entries.en: The soreness in his shoulders reminded him of yesterday's long canoe trip.
entries.zh: 肩膀的酸痛让他想起了昨天漫长的独木舟之旅。

entries.en: We searched exhaustively through every drawer and cupboard for the missing photograph.
entries.zh: 我们把每个抽屉和橱柜都彻底找遍了，想找到那张不见的照片。

entries.en: The festival encourages the perpetuation of local crafts through workshops for children.
entries.zh: 这个节日通过面向儿童的工坊活动，推动当地手工艺长久传承。

entries.en: Rainwater poured from the broken drainpipe onto the path below.
entries.zh: 雨水从破损的排水管流到下面的小路上。

entries.en: The corridor was dismally dark after the last ceiling light failed.
entries.zh: 最后一盏顶灯坏了之后，走廊黑得阴沉沉的。

entries.en: Leaden clouds hung over the harbour throughout the cold afternoon.
entries.zh: 整个寒冷的下午，铅灰色的云都笼罩着港口。

entries.en: The hearse moved slowly through the village ahead of the mourners.
entries.zh: 灵车缓缓穿过村庄，送葬者跟在后面。

entries.meaningZh: 浣熊（美式非正式动物义；该词另有侮辱黑人的严重种族歧视义，勿用来称人）
entries.en: A coon with a striped tail scrambled up the tree beside the shed.
entries.zh: 一只尾巴带条纹的浣熊迅速爬上了棚屋旁的树。

entries.en: The carpenter used a crowbar to lift the damaged floorboard.
entries.zh: 木匠用撬棍撬起了损坏的地板。

entries.en: We enjoyed an unhurried breakfast before setting off along the coast.
entries.zh: 沿海岸出发前，我们从容地吃了顿早餐。

entries.en: The chimney sweep left sooty footprints across the pale kitchen tiles.
entries.zh: 烟囱清扫工在浅色厨房地砖上留下了一串黑乎乎的煤灰脚印。

entries.en: The mother cat gently carried her kitten by the scruff of its neck.
entries.zh: 母猫轻轻叼住小猫的后颈，把它带走。

entries.en: He let out a loud burp after finishing his fizzy drink.
entries.zh: 喝完汽水后，他响亮地打了一个饱嗝。

entries.en: He ordered a kipper with toast for breakfast at the seaside hotel.
entries.zh: 他在海滨旅馆吃早餐时，点了一条配吐司的腌熏鲱鱼。

entries.en: The puppet walked funnily across the stage, making the children laugh.
entries.zh: 木偶以滑稽的步态走过舞台，逗得孩子们大笑。

entries.en: The gardener looked displeased when he saw footprints across the flowerbed.
entries.zh: 园丁看到花坛上横穿而过的脚印时，显得很不高兴。

entries.en: A stray cornflake crunched under my shoe beside the breakfast table.
entries.zh: 早餐桌旁，一片掉落的玉米片被我的鞋踩得嘎吱一响。

entries.en: She pulled on a wool balaclava before leaving the mountain hut.
entries.zh: 离开山间小屋前，她戴上了一顶包住头颈的羊毛防寒帽。

entries.en: The boat's lights made a narrow trail across the inky water.
entries.zh: 船灯在漆黑的水面上映出一条狭窄的光带。

entries.en: The report criticised the unscientific methods used to compare the two products.
entries.zh: 报告批评了用于比较这两种产品的不科学方法。

entries.en: A teal paddled quietly among the reeds at the edge of the pond.
entries.zh: 一只小野鸭在池塘边的芦苇间静静地游动。

entries.meaningZh: 从岸上可见的近海海面
entries.en: Several fishing boats waited in the offing beyond the harbour entrance.
entries.zh: 几艘渔船停在港口入口外、从岸上可见的海面上等候。

entries.en: The paediatrician answered questions about her working day during the school visit.
entries.zh: 那位儿科医师到访学校时，回答了大家关于她日常工作的问题。

entries.en: A fresh fall of snow began to whiten the distant hills.
entries.zh: 新落的一场雪开始把远处的山丘染白。

entries.en: The botanist examined an androgynous inflorescence containing both male and female flowers.
entries.zh: 植物学家检查了一个同时含有雄花和雌花的雌雄同序花序。

entries.en: The medical lecture included a section on the classification of epileptic seizures.
entries.zh: 医学讲座中有一部分介绍了癫痫发作的分类。

entries.en: The destruction of the village was condemned as an act of barbarism.
entries.zh: 摧毁那座村庄的行为受到谴责，被称为野蛮暴行。

entries.en: We met after lunch to brainstorm ideas for the school festival.
entries.zh: 午饭后，我们聚在一起，为学校庆典集思广益。

entries.en: The students gathered in the lunchroom after the morning classes ended.
entries.zh: 上午的课程结束后，学生们聚集在便餐厅里。

entries.en: A large conch rested on the shelf beside the sailor's photograph.
entries.zh: 水手照片旁的架子上放着一只大海螺壳。

entries.en: The charity provides free music lessons for underprivileged children in the city.
entries.zh: 该慈善机构为城里生活条件贫困的儿童提供免费音乐课。

entries.en: A wooden footbridge crosses the stream just beyond the old mill.
entries.zh: 一座木制人行桥横跨在旧磨坊稍远处的小溪上。

entries.meaningZh: 监狱（主要用于美式英语）
entries.en: The old jailhouse now houses a small museum of local history.
entries.zh: 那座旧监狱如今是一家小型地方历史博物馆。

entries.en: The study invited menopausal women to describe their experiences in anonymous interviews.
entries.zh: 这项研究邀请绝经期女性通过匿名访谈讲述自己的经历。

entries.en: She glanced fleetingly at the clock before returning to her work.
entries.zh: 她飞快地瞥了一眼时钟，又继续工作。

entries.en: An encyclical letter from the pope formed the centrepiece of the church exhibition.
entries.zh: 一封由教皇发出、广泛传阅的通谕信是教会展览的核心展品。

entries.en: It seemed churlish to complain after they had cooked us such a generous meal.
entries.zh: 他们为我们做了如此丰盛的一餐，再抱怨就显得无礼了。

entries.en: The science fiction film imagines a group preparing for doomsday underground.
entries.zh: 这部科幻片设想了一群人在地下为世界末日做准备的情景。

entries.en: The missing timestamps weakened the plausibility of his account of the journey.
entries.zh: 时间记录的缺失削弱了他对旅程叙述的可信程度。

entries.en: The cyclist came down the steep hill at breakneck speed.
entries.zh: 那名骑车人以危险的高速冲下了陡坡。

entries.en: Some bozo had parked across both spaces outside the shop.
entries.zh: 某个家伙把车横着停，占了店外两个车位。

entries.en: The laboratory measured how quickly the cells could metabolize the sugar.
entries.zh: 实验室测量了细胞代谢这种糖的速度。

entries.en: We were flabbergasted when our tiny team won the regional competition.
entries.zh: 我们这个小小的队伍赢得地区比赛时，大家都惊得目瞪口呆。
